==Purpose of template==
Link to a dedicated wiki page for a given trope.

== Usage ==

<code><nowiki>{{</nowiki></code>Trope|''trope''|''text''<code><nowiki>}}</nowiki></code>

== Examples ==

{|class=wikitable
!Code!!Result
|-
|<pre>{{Trope|Lemony Narrator}}</pre>||{{Trope|Lemony Narrator}}
|-
|<pre>{{Trope|Lemony Narrator|narrator}}</pre>||{{Trope|Lemony Narrator|narrator}}
|-
|<pre>{{Trope}}</pre>||{{Trope}}
|-
|<pre>{{Trope||narrator}}</pre>||{{Trope||narrator}}
|}
